answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The final reply groups the problems as 'Fix before launch' (1-5), then 'Fix next' (6-10), then 'Smaller issues', most severe first. It also names what it could not check: 'Not tested: real VoiceOver and TalkBack.' and a 'Check with the agency (my inference, not something I could confirm)' section.

mapping.title: Tapping 'Book this slot' twice cancels the booking; done page still headed 'Booked'
mapping.reason: Says the button gives no feedback for 1.5 s and a second tap saves the booking as cancelled, while the page still says 'Booked'. That is exactly D09.

mapping.title: 5-minute hold runs out unseen; slot becomes a dash with no way back
mapping.reason: Describes the hidden five-minute hold, the 'This slot is no longer available.' message and the summary's slot turning into a dash. That is D08.

mapping.title: Today's past or imminent slots are offered as free and refused at the last step
mapping.reason: Slots that have passed or start within 30 minutes can be chosen and are refused only on the final step. That is D06.

mapping.title: Van/trailer permit not checked on the vehicle step; the error at the end has no link to the field
mapping.reason: Covers the permit field's behaviour, Next on the vehicle step accepting an empty permit, and the confirm page's 'A van needs a permit number' error with no way back to the field. The instructions put all of this under D07.

mapping.title: Slot grid wider than the screen at 320 and 360 px
mapping.reason: Says a script sizes the grid's columns without allowing for the margins, so the page scrolls sideways at 360 px and below and the last column is cut off. That is D04.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots jump to the front of the grid, out of time and focus order
mapping.reason: The order:-1 style moves 'Few left' slots ahead of the Morning heading, and the keyboard and screen-reader order no longer match the screen. That is D10.

mapping.title: Slot buttons show no keyboard focus
mapping.reason: Says an injected .slot:focus{outline:0} style hides the focus ring on every slot button. That is D05.

mapping.title: 'Few left' label has low contrast in both themes
mapping.reason: Gives 3.0:1 in light and 3.4:1 in dark against the 4.5:1 needed for the 'Few left' tag. That is the D03 contrast defect.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day
mapping.reason: Going back opens on 'Today' with nothing selected, while vehicle, waste and details are kept. That is D12.

mapping.title: Confirmation page doesn't show the day, time or vehicle
mapping.reason: Says the 'Booked' page shows only the reference and not the day, time, vehicle or registration. That is D14.

mapping.title: No loading message while slots arrive; Next does nothing meanwhile
mapping.reason: Slots take about a second to appear, nothing shows in the meantime, and tapping Next during that time does nothing. That is the wait itself, D01.

mapping.title: 'Another day' date field asks for DD/MM/YYYY but the iPhone numeric keypad has no '/'
mapping.reason: Residents book mostly on phones. A format hint that cannot be typed on the keypad offered makes them stall or doubt their entry when picking a day outside the buttons. No ground-truth defect covers date entry.

mapping.title: Slot length and 'arrive within your slot' only in a tooltip
mapping.reason: Says the slot information sits only in a tooltip that phones never show. That is D13.

mapping.title: Mobile number required though it is only used for a reminder
mapping.reason: A required field that only feeds an optional reminder stops residents without a mobile from booking a council service at all. No ground-truth defect covers it.

mapping.title: First slot count not announced to screen readers
mapping.reason: The count is marked as live only after its first update, so a screen reader misses the day's count the first time. That is D11.

mapping.title: 'Today' and the day buttons are fixed to 12 October 2026
mapping.reason: The review offers this as an unconfirmed inference ('These may be demo stubs'). It concerns how the build is wired, not anything a resident meets in this flow, so it is speculative here.

mapping.title: Slots and bookings look like placeholders; no server request
mapping.reason: Also flagged by the review itself as an unconfirmed inference about demo stubs. It is a question about the backend, not a usability problem for residents shown in the flow.
